Posted 2026-11-21T00:26Z. The brief handed to the isolated contract reviewer for PR #35965 (owed because two `hits` paths sit under `.claude/**`, so the record must carry `Rule-change-verified:`). The record follows as its own comment.

## Contract review brief — PR #35965 @ `ef35ea3ef584c32ac9af33ebd0856799217f4bd1` (card #35693)

You review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Render ONE `## Contract review` record on this head — its shape is
`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md,scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` — with a PASS or FAIL verdict, and post it as ONE comment
on the PR or its card.

Inputs — these and nothing else:
  · card #35693: its body and EVERY comment (rulings and earlier records included)
  · PR #35965: its body, its file list, and the net diff against `main` at `ef35ea3ef584c32ac9af33ebd0856799217f4bd1`
  · the check-runs on `ef35ea3ef584c32ac9af33ebd0856799217f4bd1`: their conclusions ARE the gate verdicts
⛔ Not the dispatch order, ⛔ not the dispatching seat's own conclusions — this brief is adversarial by design.

Scope — the paths `reviewFace` returns as `hits` on this PR's file list: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md,scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs;
  plus every file IN THIS DIFF that directly implements or enforces them — the gate that enforces a rule, the code
  a jsdoc or schema line describes, the validator a skill teaches — reviewed for agreement with the contract.
  Widen it freely, ⛔ never below `hits`; the record's `Scope:` line names the implementing files apart from `hits`.
  The rest of the diff (tests, unrelated modules, lockfiles, generated output, changesets) is the lane seat's
  ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`, exactly as a standalone PR of those files.
  ④ judges the `hits` files and those implementing files ONLY:
  lockfiles, generated output, changesets and prose elsewhere in the PR are not reviewed;
  code outside the diff is READ to judge them, never reviewed.

Rule change — a `hits` path sits under `.claude/**`: the PR body declares `Rule-change:` and you verify it against the diff.
  Write `Rule-change-verified: none` ONLY when no changed hunk alters what an agent may do without the maintainer
  (merge, bypass a check, change repository settings), what gets done and in what order (grading, dispatch, scope), or
  what must go to him (decisions, maintainer actions); process steps, scripts, wording, slimming and file moves are not rule
  changes. Write `ruled` ONLY when every such hunk copies the ruling the PR body quotes on its `Ruling-ref:` line — check the
  copy against the quoted words, do not re-rule it. Otherwise `yes`: the pull request then waits for the maintainer.

⛔ READ-ONLY. No worktree, no checkout, no build, no test run, no gate re-run, no ablation: the check-runs
   on the head already answered every derived gate family, and a local run costs more than it returns.
   If ONE probe is unavoidable, the record's `Local-runs:` line says `probe — REASON`; otherwise `none`.
   Scratch space is `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/3d3cbaf6-4903-5fed-92d4-c2b94a45e868/scratchpad/pr-35965/` alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
  ③ Boundary flags — every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry answered, or escalated.
     On every face, SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join where SQL could push down is a
     finding unless a reason is given (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5: SQL first).
  ④ Design judgment — for EVERY `hits` file: does the change hold against the code it cites and the
     scenario it is accepted against? A skill file against the card's eval prompt and the spec it teaches
     on `main`; a schema file against the ruling or ADR it implements and its first consumer; an ADR
     against its first consumer and its execution plan. For EVERY implementing file in the diff: does the
     code agree with the contract, sentence by sentence? Read the cited code in the live tree, and try to
     break the design.
     Grade each finding must-fix, should-fix or nit — a nit has no effect on correctness or the contract.
     A must-fix is a FAIL; a must-fix or should-fix earns a delta review of its fix; nits alone end the round.
     Spell a must-fix or should-fix with its id and grade, `S1 (should-fix) — …`, and a clean round as
     `No must-fix, no should-fix.`: the queue guard reads a graded finding as OPEN on this head and
     refuses the record; the delta record names those it closes by id alone, `S1: closed`.
     A nit is fixed only on the prose faces, or left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card: a fix
     anywhere else moves the head, and this record no longer covers it.
     ⛔ Judge the tree, never the PR body's account of it.
Sign `Implemented-by:` with the dev's branch and `Reviewed-by:` with your session id — the value is the FIRST
thing after each colon.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a)

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感，只改车队内部的巡检口径。
- 以前规则里有两处说法打架：席位巡检的「发版阻塞」一项写「三个仓三张板」，你的发版清单定义写「主仓和 cloud 两张板」。现在巡检一项改为与发版清单一致，只数主仓和 cloud。
- hotcrm 等其他仓上的 p0 不再计入这一项。你的发版清单本来就只看这两张板，所以你看到的清单不变。
- 巡检工具读不到 cloud 板时，会明说「cloud 读不到」并把整次巡检标为不完整，不会给出一个看似干净的 0。席 1 的账号读不了 cloud，所以它的巡检会一直标为不完整、点名 cloud。这是席位选的做法。
- 座位贴里补了一行「接卡行」的定义，在同一文件里压缩措辞付出字节，两个文件的上限都下调了，没有抬高。
- 要你做什么：这个 PR 改了受管的规则文本，L2 落下 `Rule-change-verified` 后需要你批准一次（Tier H）。

**Head reviewed:** `ef35ea3ef584c32ac9af33ebd0856799217f4bd1` on main `7de1bad5`.

- 1 commit, 4 files, +85/−49. `Fixes #35693`, `Rule-change: none`, `skip-changeset`.
- The claim (7032022380, amended 7053554052 to this card thread) bounds the file surface. The diff stays inside it.

### Against the card and triage

- **The arm taken.** Card #35693's Expected says the two passages must agree, "unless the maintainer names a third board". Triage 7025070515 sends any third-repo reading to the decision box. The PR takes the other arm: no third repo is named.
  - `seat-lifecycle.md:79` now reads 「窗内主仓、cloud open `priority:p0` 之和,归零 = 两张板都空」.
  - That is the same set and zero condition as `seat-post-protocol.md` 发版板运维 (producers 主仓 / cloud, 「两仓两条查询」, 「归零 = 可发版指两张板都空」), which is unchanged.
  - Done-when ① holds.
- **Done-when ②.** `fleet-roster --health` leg 5 sums `RELEASE_BOARD_REPOS = [objectstack, cloud]` whatever `--repos` holds. The 「三仓」 unread leg is gone; the 窗内 leg stays. `HEALTH_RULE_FILES` now pins the definition's producer and zero-condition phrases, as well as the query. The rule text and the reader cannot drift apart silently.
- **The rider** (N1 of 7031081983 / 7031399118 on #35740) is `seat-post-protocol.md:18`, 「说明段接卡行点名本席接的 `area:*`…」. The names match the 接卡行 / 接卡面 text that #35740 put on main: `area-lease.md:7`, `coordinator.md:8`, `lanes/objectstack.md:8`. #35740 is merged (`e3e202a9`), so the claim's serial condition is met.

### `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`

- **`judgeHealth`.** For each release board:
  - a walked repo gives its walk count;
  - a walked-but-unreadable repo gives `n: null`, and its gap is already named by the readings line;
  - a board outside `--repos` takes `readReleaseBoard`'s platform `total_count`;
  - anything else pushes a named gap and gives `null`.

  So no board can read as zero by omission.
- **`readReleaseBoard`.** It refuses a non-`ok` answer, a missing `total_count` and `incomplete_results: true`, each with its reason. This is the runbook's per_page=1 → `total_count` reading.
- **`readHealth`.** It asks for a board's count only when the board is outside `--repos`, so there is no double read.
- **Run at this head (worktree):**
  - `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`: **150 cases in 12 batteries pass**. The health battery floor went 25 → 28 for the three new cases.
  - `--health --fixture scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json` prints `5 发版阻塞 … 1 (objectstack 1 · cloud UNREAD) … ⛔ INCOMPLETE run`, matching the body's two-minute check.

### Skill text and ratchet

- **The compression in `seat-post-protocol.md`.** I read each of the 20 or so trimmed lines against its old text. Every one keeps its meaning; the cuts are particles and doubled words (「轮次合计」→「合计」, 「是维护者在 UI 上的可调项」→「由维护者在 UI 调」, a `scripts/pm/` path prefix, and so on). The serial-queue sentence is joined onto one line. No rule, list item or `⛔` was dropped.
- **Re-measured at this head:**

  | File | Before | After | Ceiling |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `seat-lifecycle.md` | 9071 | 9070 | 9070 |
  | `seat-post-protocol.md` | 7722 | 7720 | 7720 |

  - Headroom is 0 on both rows. Both are lowered, none raised, and no ruling is needed for a lowering.
  - #35740's two ruled raises (`area-lease.md` 6586, `coordinator.md` 4265) are kept as landed.
  - `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` passes, as does `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (60 authored files within ceilings).

### `Rule-change: none`: my reading, for the L2

**Plausible.** The consumer the maintainer reads is unchanged: the release list in `seat-post-protocol.md`, two repos, two queries. The patrol metric is made to agree with it. The rider names an existing part of the seat post, and the rest is compression and a read-only script.

The one hunk an L2 should weigh is that a `priority:p0` on hotcrm, objectui or mobile no longer counts in leg 5. I read that as a reporting reading aligned to the release definition, not a change to what must go to the maintainer, because his own list never counted those boards. The verdict is the L2's (`Rule-change-verified:`). I do not rule it here.

### Nits (no action needed)

- **N1.** With cloud UNREAD, leg 5's total prints the readable boards' sum (`1`), because `total()` adds `null` as 0. Every indicator line of an INCOMPLETE run is already stamped `⛔ INCOMPLETE run — not a clean reading`, so it cannot be copied out as clean. `≥1` or `UNREAD` in the total would say it once more.
- **N2.** Seat 1 cannot read cloud (HTTP 422), so its patrol `--health` will now exit 4 every run, with `cloud UNREAD` as the only gap. That is the seat's chosen reading (06:38Z, question 1 = A). The cost is that a second, real gap shares the same exit code; the gap list still names each one.

### Governance and landing

- `check-governed-merges --pr 35965`, run from a worktree at this head: **GOVERNED, Tier H**. The `.claude/**` paths are covered by the `none` declaration, and `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` is not on the register. Size 134 lines.
- CI: per the request, 49 runs (26 success, 23 skipped). Not re-read here.
- **Owed:** the seat's isolated contract L2 on this head, with a `Rule-change-verified:` line, and an APPROVED review from os-zhuang. L1 does not replace L2.
- A new push needs a delta L1 unless it is a clean main merge. This review does not approve, mark ready, enqueue or request review.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ef35ea3ef584c32ac9af33ebd0856799217f4bd1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md,scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs + none
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #35965, card #35693, net diff against `main` `7de1bad5c`. The diff is exactly the four `hits` files, so no implementing file sits outside them and no remainder is left to the lane seat. Read: the card body and its three comments (triage 2026-11-19, claim 2026-11-20, claim amendment 2026-11-20), the PR body and file list, the net diff, the two skill files and `fleet-roster.mjs` on both sides with `git show`, and the 49 check-runs on this head.

Rule-change check, hunk by hunk. The PR body declares `Rule-change: none`, and the diff bears it out.

- `seat-lifecycle.md`, the one metric line: 「窗内三仓 … 三张板都空」 becomes 「窗内主仓、cloud … 两张板都空」. This makes the line agree with the definition `seat-post-protocol.md` 发版板运维 already carries on `main` (two producers, two queries, 「归零 = 可发版指两张板都空」). It names no third board, which is the one arm triage reserved for the maintainer. It changes a report indicator's reading; it grants no agent a new action, reorders nothing, and removes nothing that must go to the maintainer.
- `seat-post-protocol.md`, the new line 「说明段接卡行点名本席接的 `area:*`;接卡面变即重写,重述、接管、移席照抄」: a process step for keeping an existing part of the seat post. `coordinator.md` line 8 and `lanes/objectstack.md` line 8 on `main` already place the intake line in the post's 说明段 and already say who changes the intake (the maintainer names an `area:*`, the seat writes it in). The new line says when the line is rewritten and that it is copied; it does not say who may change the intake.
- `seat-post-protocol.md`, the compressed lines: each read against `main`. Each keeps its meaning. The closest call is 「Routine 席的档位与 cron 是维护者在 UI 上的可调项」 to 「由维护者在 UI 调」: both leave tier and cron with the maintainer, so nothing is loosened.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `fleet-roster.mjs`: scripts. Two ceilings are lowered, none raised; the reader is read-only.

### ① Derived judgments

- Leg 5's repo set is now fixed at `RELEASE_BOARD_REPOS` (`objectstack-ai/objectstack`, `objectstack-ai/cloud`) whatever `--repos` holds. Right: it is the set the release-list definition names, and the card's Done-when asks for exactly this.
- An open `priority:p0` on hotcrm, objectui or mobile leaves leg 5. Right under the definition (those repos have no producer and no query in 发版板运维); the self-test pins it with the hotcrm p0 the fixture holds.
- The repo-count unread leg is removed from `HEALTH_UNREAD_LEGS` (5 legs to 4) and the 窗内 leg stays. Right: the set is now read, the window still is not.
- A release board that does not answer is a gap: INCOMPLETE, exit 4, `UNREAD` on the line. Right: it follows the file's own header contract (a gap is named, never a clean-looking number).
- `judgeHealth` gains an optional `boards` argument and `releaseBlockers.perRepo` entries gain `via` and may carry `n: null`. Right: nothing outside `fleet-roster.mjs` imports `judgeHealth`, `readHealth` or reads `releaseBlockers` (searched the head tree), so no consumer breaks.
- `HEALTH_RULE_FILES` pins the new metric line and three phrases of the definition. Right: all four are present, byte for byte, in the head's skill files.
- `CEILINGS`: `seat-post-protocol.md` 7722 to 7720 and `seat-lifecycle.md` 9071 to 9070. Right: `wc -c` on the head's blobs gives 7720 and 9070, and `main`'s give 7722 and 9071. Both rows only shrink.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, `skip-changeset` label, `Clause-②: no`. Correct: the four paths are `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**`, neither ships in a package, and no published surface moves. `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Seat 1 cannot read cloud, so its `--health` run now ends INCOMPLETE (exit 4) with `cloud UNREAD` where it could exit 0 before. Answered: this is what the header contract requires of an unread board. Nothing in `scripts/**`, `.github/**` or the skill reads `--health`'s exit as a gate (searched the head tree), so no gate turns red. One consequence to know: for that identity exit 4 is now the steady state, so the exit code alone no longer tells a new gap from the standing one; the gap list on the last line still does.
- The PR body cites a seat ruling of 2026-11-20 06:38Z for two choices (an unread board is a gap; the metric line names the two repos and drops the pointer to 发版板运维). That ruling is not on the card thread, so it was not an input. Both choices were judged on the tree and hold without it: the first as above, the second because `HEALTH_RULE_FILES` pins both passages, so they cannot drift apart silently.
- The rider (nit N1 of the records on PR #35740) is in the claim's file surface and is paid for inside the same file: the file shrinks by 2 bytes with the line added.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:i18n-coverage` were not run by the dev. Answered by CI: every non-skipped check-run on this head concluded success, the lint, PM dispatch-gates, tooling self-test and Governed Surface Queue Guard jobs included.
- The card and the PR carry no `open_questions`.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds no query against a data store; its one new read is a single `per_page=1` search count per board.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`seat-lifecycle.md`. The metric line now names the same two boards and the same zero condition as 发版板运维. Both of the card's Done-when items hold on the head. No other file under `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**` or `AGENTS.md` still says 三仓 or 三张板.

`seat-post-protocol.md`. The intake line sits after the stub lines and agrees with the three places that point at it (`area-lease.md` line 7, `coordinator.md` line 8, `lanes/objectstack.md` line 8). It does not collide with 「坐席、串行队/cron 改、撞墙、移交才刷存根」: that line limits refreshes of the stub, and the intake line lives in 说明段, which the file already treats as a separate part (line 40, 留守登记 = 说明段一行). `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` shortened to `post-stamped.mjs` matches the spelling the next line already uses.

`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. Two numbers, both equal to the landed sizes; the two ruled raises from PR #35740 are untouched.

`fleet-roster.mjs`, sentence by sentence against its header and jsdoc:

- 「a board in `--repos` is read off its walk」: `judgeHealth` takes `counts.p0.walk.length` from the reading, and `readHealthRepo` already checks that walk against the platform count. Holds.
- 「a board outside it by its platform count alone」: `readHealth` calls `readReleaseBoard` only for boards not in `repos`, through the same paced `get`. No second walk, no double count. Holds.
- 「a board that does not answer is a named gap」: a failed read, a missing `total_count` and `incomplete_results` each return `unreadable`; a board in neither list gets 「was not read」. A walked board that is unreadable already has its gap from the readings. Holds, and each path has a self-test case.
- 「`--repos` never changes this set」: the map runs over `RELEASE_BOARD_REPOS`, never over `readings`. Holds.

Attempts to break it: a board spelled in another case in `--repos` falls to the count path and is counted once; `--repos` naming only a non-board repo that does not answer gives exit 3 and prints no indicator; both boards unread with another repo readable gives exit 4 with both marked `UNREAD`.

Nits, neither affecting correctness or the contract:

- N1 (nit): `releaseBlockers.total` adds a `null` board as 0, so with one board unread the line reads, for example, `1 (objectstack 1 · cloud UNREAD); zero means both boards are empty`, and `--json` carries `total` as a plain number. The line carries the INCOMPLETE mark and the per-board `UNREAD`, and the JSON carries `exit: 4` and the gap, so no reading comes out clean; this is also how the other four indicators already treat an unreadable repo. Left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card.
- N2 (nit): the renderer comment (line 763) and one self-test case (line 1404) still quote the old phrase 「every board read is empty」, which the renderer no longer prints, so that one negative assertion can no longer fail. The same case's other leg (no indicator line at all on a CAN'T READ run) still pins the behaviour. Left as a follow-up; a fix here would move the head.
